new: Each static no-reverse-flow arrangement of Subsection~\ref{subsec:res_coordination} was solved from three starts (Table~\ref{tab:appE_benchmark}); the best is reported in Table~\ref{tab:res_benchmark}, and the spread over the starts is its band. Each arrangement is solved in three phases (Section~\ref{sec:case_settings}): the distribution networks' dispatch and the transmission network's dispatch against it, from which the curtailment columns are taken; a re-evaluation of each distribution network at the transmission network's interface voltage, with its decisions held at the first phase and its voltage, thermal and no-reverse-flow rows switched off, in which the exceedance columns count the network-hours (of 864: three networks, twelve blocks, 24~h) whose interface flow exceeds the no-reverse-flow limit and give the largest exceedance; and the consistency pass, a re-solve of each distribution network at that voltage with the rows on, followed by the transmission network's dispatch, whose cost is the $Q$ of Table~\ref{tab:appE_benchmark}. The consistency column is the change of $Q$ from the first phase to the pass.
